9a6bc5723a9fbc23.description: The Team We are an award winning global consultancy and have been named Building’s Engineering Consultant of the Year in 2024, 2022 and 2021. We are at the forefront of the industry, priding ourselves on our exemplary track record of designing innovative and sustainable projects. Sustainability runs through everything we do at Cundall, and our people are empowered to drive change and decarbonise the built environment. By the end of this decade, we have set ourselves an ambitious goal to only work on projects that meet our zero carbon design criteria, a commitment we have called our Zero Carbon Design 2030 goal. We need engineers who share this passion for sustainability and thrive in designing energy efficient buildings and communities. Cundall’s Structural Engineering team prides itself in their exemplary track record of designing innovative and sustainable structural solutions, that minimise the use of natural resources. As one of the longest established of Cundall’s many disciplines, the Structural team are a source of world leading expertise – and offer a pro-active and collaborative approach to skill development, and professional excellence. The Role This is an excellent opportunity for someone with an experienced background in structural engineering to join our team at our office in Riyadh to work on the design of some of the most exciting structural design projects in KSA and regionally. As part of our established team of expert engineers and CAD technicians, and working closely with colleagues of various disciplines, you will prepare detailed structural calculations for multiple materials and using appropriate software. You will work across a variety of sectors such as Education, Commercial, Healthcare, Retail and Critical Systems, and will have the opportunity over time to assume greater levels of responsibility and autonomy as your professional skills develop, and as you work and are supported towards Chartership. The Skills Having already been accredited with a BEng degree level (or equivalent), you will have gained strong practical experience of structural engineering within a consultancy environment, and be proficient in the use of design and modelling software such as Etabs, Safe, SAP, Robot, Prokon, and IDEA StatiCa. You will be familiar with producing creative design solutions in multiple materials, including steel, reinforced concrete and masonry, and crucially - have a passion for creative and intuitive design. Given the collaborative and client focussed nature of this role, excellent communication and presentation skills and experience of using your initiative to overcome challenges are essential. Key Requirements Chartered or actively working towards getting chartered (MIStructE) Candidates with knowledge of ETABS, SAFE, SAP etc. Knowledge of parametric designing and associated programmes would be advantageous. A knowledge of the Building Codes [UAE/KSA] and international codes. 8 to 12 years post graduate experience within a similar role / consultancy environment. Experience in preparing structural calculations, design reports and presentations. Experience in monitoring the works of engineers and technicians and reviewing /verifying their work. Able to work independently and in a team of multidisciplinary professionals. Job Description Your career at Cundall We know that to be the best at what we do we need a diverse workforce underpinned by an inclusive culture. Creating environments where everyone can find joy doing their best work is also great for everyone. That’s why we positively welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and identities, and encourage, support, and celebrate the diverse voices of our people.

9a0ac1739a441026.description: Our client is seeking a Senior Development Director to lead the front-end development of a substantial portfolio of villas, apartments and townhouses in Riyadh. The role sits within a major destination-led development and carries influence across product strategy, feasibility, design direction, commercial planning, and delivery readiness. This is a senior client-side development appointment for someone who has created and delivered residential product, rather than managed construction after the principal development decisions have already been taken. The role You will lead a portfolio of villas and townhouse developments through the early and middle stages of the development lifecycle. Your remit will include: Leading projects from initial feasibility through to delivery readiness Defining product strategy, unit mix, positioning, phasing, and development briefs Owning feasibility studies, financial modelling, business planning, and commercial optimisation Balancing market demand, product quality, design, cost, programme, and profitability Managing masterplanning, design development, consultants, approvals, and procurement strategy Testing and challenging assumptions across design, commercial, and delivery teams Representing the development function in senior stakeholder and investment discussions Building effective relationships with internal teams, external consultants, authorities, and delivery partners Improving development governance, decision-making, and processes across the portfolio Although the role retains accountability across the full development cycle, its principal focus is the front end, where product, investment, and development strategy are established. The person You will be an experienced client-side residential developer with a strong record of delivering villas, townhouses, housing communities, or comparable low-rise residential product. You should bring: Substantial residential development experience gained with a recognised developer, investor, or development organisation A clear record of leading multiple projects from feasibility and product definition through design and into delivery Strong financial appraisal, feasibility, and commercial decision-making capability Experience defining residential products, unit mixes, positioning, and development briefs The ability to balance design quality with commercial performance, programme, and delivery risk Experience managing multidisciplinary teams, consultants, and senior stakeholders The credibility to present recommendations, defend a business case, and challenge constructively Stable career tenure and evidence of increasing responsibility Middle East development experience is preferred, but not essential A recognised university degree is required, with real estate, finance, or commercial qualifications advantageous Candidates should be able to describe the residential projects they have led in specific terms, including unit numbers, product type, market positioning, project scale, development stages, and their personal accountability. This is not a pure project management, design management, construction delivery, operations, asset management, sales, or marketing role. Candidates whose experience is predominantly contractor, PMC, consultancy, or site delivery-led will not match the mandate. The opportunity The successful candidate will join a residential business responsible for creating new neighbourhoods within one of Saudi Arabia’s most significant destination-led developments. The villas and townhouses portfolio forms an important part of the wider residential strategy. This appointment will help determine what is developed, how the product is positioned, how the commercial case is structured, and how projects are prepared for successful delivery. The role offers long-term portfolio scale, direct access to senior decision-makers, and real influence over the development direction.

Maintain production quality in accordance with established tissue quality standards. Monitor machine parameters, stock preparation, and tissue formation processes. Ensure optimal operation of tissue machines, Yankee dryers, shoe presses, and related systems. Identify production issues and coordinate corrective actions to minimize downtime. Ensure compliance with industrial safety procedures, including LOTO. Coordinate with production, maintenance, and quality control teams to achieve production targets. 9a06720945e3ebb3.description: About the Detection Analyst Role at NourNet NourNet is seeking a Detection Analyst to join our team in Riyadh. This full-time role focuses on enhancing our security posture by developing and optimizing detection capabilities across various security platforms. The analyst will play a key role in identifying and responding to security threats. Role Overview The Detection Analyst is responsible for the development, maintenance, and optimization of correlation rules, detection logic, dashboards, and reports within SIEM/XDR platforms. This involves continuous analysis of security data to improve detection effectiveness and minimize false positives. Key Responsibilities Analyze alert patterns, security events, and incident data to identify detection gaps and tuning opportunities. Translate threat intelligence findings and incident response insights into actionable detection rules and use cases. Perform regression testing for new and updated detection rules to validate functionality, accuracy, and performance. Maintain comprehensive documentation for detection rules, including logic, data sources, expected behavior, and tuning history. Collaborate with Tier-1 and Tier-2 SOC analysts to gather feedback and continuously improve detection effectiveness. Map detection use cases and rules to the MITRE ATT&CK framework and applicable regulatory controls. Support the integration and optimization of detection and incident response workflows using Cortex XSOAR, where applicable. Support continuous improvement of detection coverage while minimizing false positives and improving alert quality. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh. The Detection Analyst will work as part of a dedicated security team, collaborating with various internal stakeholders to maintain and enhance the organization's security posture. Application Process Candidates interested in this Detection Analyst position are encouraged to apply. Further details regarding the application process will be provided upon inquiry.

9a97203902299a53.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة الانشاءات وخدمات الطرق للمقاولات العامه لصاحبها/حمد عب عن مهندس معماري للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تصميم المباني والإشراف على تنفيذها، ويستهدف المرشحين ذوي الخبرة الحديثة. الغرض من الوظيفة يتولى المهندس المعماري مسؤولية تصميم المباني الجديدة، بالإضافة إلى تصميم الملحقات أو التعديلات على المباني القائمة. كما يقدم المشورة المتخصصة بشأن ترميم الممتلكات القديمة والمحافظة عليها، ويساهم في اختيار المواقع المناسبة للمشاريع ومباشرة أعمال الإنشاءات لضمان تنفيذ التصاميم وفقاً للمعايير المطلوبة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع التصاميم المعمارية لمشاريع الإنشاءات المختلفة. إدارة فريق التصميم فيما يتعلق باختيار المواد وتطوير المواصفات الفنية. إعداد نماذج بالحجم الطبيعي، رسومات تفصيلية، ونماذج رقمية للمشاريع. المساعدة في عملية اختيار المقاولين والمواد اللازمة للمشروعات. تقديم الدعم الفني لمشروعات الإنشاء ومباشرة تنفيذ التصميم من قِبل المقاولين. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة المعمارية أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تصميم المباني الجديدة وتعديل القائمة منها. مهارات جيدة في إعداد الرسومات والنماذج. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية، ضمن فريق عمل مؤسسة الانشاءات وخدمات الطرق للمقاولات العامه لصاحبها/حمد عب. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة.

9adf4472914ff40b.description: About Four Seasons Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture. At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us. About the location: Soon to be one of the region’s foremost luxury beachside destinations, The Red Sea will comprise of the idyllic natural islands and lagoons across 200 kms of coastline along the western coast of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, between the cities of Umluj and Al Wajh. The new Four Seasons Resort will be located on Shura Island, the hub of the development and home to a yacht marina, leisure and lifestyle facilities, retail offerings, 18-hole golf course and more. The Red Sea destination is being built with sustainable practices and tourism at its core, with the masterplan being informed by an impressive marine spatial planning simulation to model the environmental impact of development and operations to minimize over-tourism while providing guests with an exceptional travel and lifestyle experience. The destination will also rely on renewable energy and will only develop a small portion of the islands with expansive dedicated conservation zones. The new Four Seasons Resort will offer approximately 149 rooms and suites, all with uninterrupted views over white sand beaches and crystal-clear waters. The property will also feature six restaurant and lounge outlets, meeting and events spaces, a marine discovery centre, Kids for All Seasons space and much more. Whether looking for rest and relaxation or sport and water activities, there will be something for everyone, including a full-service spa with a hammam, tennis courts, three outdoor pools with cabanas, and two separate beaches for families and adults perfect for soaking in the sun or diving down to explore the coral reefs. About Four Seasons Resort and Residences Red Sea at Shura Island: Join the team at Four Seasons Red Sea Shura Island, where our purpose is to create extraordinary guest experiences through genuine care, warm hospitality, and exceptional service. We are committed to attracting, developing, and retaining the most talented professionals in the industry to deliver the legendary Four Seasons service. About The Role The People & Culture Coordinator is responsible for overseeing the day-to-day operations of the People & Culture department, employee records management, and compliance with Saudi labor laws. The role involves supporting the People & Culture team, ensuring a professional working environment and exceptional service for all internal and external stakeholders. What You Will Do Coordinate and assist with aspects of Employee Relations. Gain an understanding of employee benefits and payroll Work closely with the other department on projects, and maintaining policies and procedures. Assist with People & Culture procedures, meetings and events. Assist with the administration in the People & Culture Office; Filing, answering phones, greeting employees, etc. What You Bring A degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred. Minimum of 1 year of experience in human resources, with experience in a hospitality or service-oriented industry. In-depth knowledge of Saudi Labor Law, employee rights, and regulations. Familiarity with P&C software and employee record management systems. Understanding of recruitment, onboarding, and employee relations practices. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to effectively interact with all levels of staff and management. High attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and P&C management software. Ability to resolve conflicts and handle sensitive employee issues with professionalism and discretion. Ability to multitask and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment. Able to lead by example, guiding team members while fostering a collaborative and supportive work environment. Strong ability to handle challenges and resolve issues efficiently and effectively. Friendly, approachable, and able to build strong relationships with both staff and management. Open to change and able to adjust responsibilities as needed to meet evolving business demands. Demonstrates a high standard of professionalism in both appearance and conduct, in line with cultural and organizational expectations. Local's only as per the Saudi labor law. What We Offer Competitive Net Salary in a Tax-Free Environment. Housing and Transportation. 30 days’ vacation. 10 days Public Holidays per year. Ticket Allowance. Living Allowance. Complimentary employee meals. Medical Insurance. Life Insurance. Employee Assistance Program. Worldwide Complimentary Room Nights with Four Seasons Laundry/dry cleaning for provided for work attire. Growth & Development opportunities Schedule & Hours This is a full-time role. Supporting the Saudi nationalization scheme, we are looking forward to connecting with Saudi nationals who have a passion for people, talent management and learning! Suitable candidates must be able to work in Saudi Arabia!

9a513f194470a699.description: About the Role Jeddah Central Development Company (JCDC) is seeking an Information Security Manager to lead and manage all activities related to protecting the company's digital and physical information assets. This full-time role is based in Makkah, specifically in Jeddah or Makkah, and involves operating within the Information Security division to implement and maintain data security policies and procedures. The manager will ensure JCDC data remains secure and compliant with all regulatory requirements. Key Responsibilities Manage the implementation of JCDC's data security strategy, ensuring alignment with business objectives. Develop and enforce data security procedures, general instructions, and administrative procedures in line with company goals and compliance. Respond to and manage data security incidents, including post-incident analysis and implementing preventive measures. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to protect defined data asset inventories and integrate data security best practices across the organization. Execute training and awareness programs to educate employees on data security practices and the importance of protecting classified information. Select and implement data security tools and technologies to enhance the security posture. Monitor industry trends, threats, and best practices in data security to keep policies and procedures current. Provide expert advice and guidance on data security matters to senior management and stakeholders. Identity and Access Management Collaborate with data owners to define and establish access controls for classified data resources. Conduct and coordinate reviews of access controls and permissions for classified data resources. Manage the process for granting, modifying, and revoking access to data resources, ensuring adherence to policies and authorization by data owners. Manage approvals for identity and access management requests across various systems (database, dataset, USB, SAP, cloud drives, e-vaults, internet URL access, DLP, RMS) to prevent data breaches. Monitor user access review activities across JCD data systems. Data Privacy and Compliance Develop and implement processes for handling data subject requests efficiently. Collaborate with all departments to integrate data privacy best practices throughout the organization. Monitor the implementation of data privacy law provisions and manage personal data requests in collaboration with the cybersecurity GRC. Select and implement data privacy tools and technologies to enhance the security posture. Lead the process of conducting Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs) and Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) for new and existing projects. Manage the organization's data breach response and notification procedures, ensuring timely and coordinated responses to incidents. Strategic and Operational Management Ensure effective cascading of divisional strategy into sectional business plans for vertical alignment and horizontal integration. Manage the achievement of assigned objectives by leading the designated section, setting individual objectives, managing performance, and developing staff. Lead talent development initiatives for the assigned section, ensuring talent availability to meet business requirements. Manage budget preparation, recommend sectional budgets, and monitor financial performance against the budget. Ensure effective implementation of policies, procedures, and controls covering all areas of assigned sectional activity. Lead the identification of opportunities for continuous improvement and sustainability of systems, processes, and practices. Ensure timely and accurate preparation of all department reports that meet JCDC requirements and quality standards. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in information security management. The role requires a strong understanding of data security strategies, regulatory compliance, and incident management. Experience in identity and access management, as well as data privacy principles, is essential.

9a74df3c95a2ce9f.description: About the Role Larsen & Toubro is seeking a T&C Protection Engineer to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves ensuring that facilities, equipment, and plants function correctly and meet client needs through comprehensive testing and commissioning activities. The engineer will be responsible for bringing products and systems to optimal operational effectiveness. Key Responsibilities Testing main advanced relays, backup relays, and auxiliary relays, executing tasks individually for BSP projects. Operating various relay software applications. Operating secondary and primary current injection kits from different manufacturers. Verifying protection schemes in the field based on thorough knowledge. Proposing improvements and offering advice on operational procedures. Scheduling and coordinating work to meet tight deadlines. Identifying problems and shortcomings within existing systems. Coordinating testing and commissioning activities with internal and external stakeholders, and providing guidance on procedures and documentation. Producing or assisting in the production of all test and commissioning documentation. Undertaking testing and commissioning activities within specified time and cost parameters. Monitoring progress, recording all test results, witnessing final testing and acceptance of equipment, and compiling documentation for the site test dossier. Ensuring the safe testing and commissioning of completed installations to achieve required plant performance in line with project programs. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering. 8-15 years of experience in testing and commissioning of EHV substations. Minimum of 5 years of experience in 380kV Substation Projects within Saudi Arabia or the GCC region. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, focusing on critical infrastructure projects within the region.

9aa1cdbfb634313b.description: About the Role Brkz is seeking a Treasury & Banking Accountant to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time role is central to ensuring the daily accuracy of bank accounts and managing the lifecycle of Letters of Credit (LCs) and cheques from issuance to fund receipt. The accountant will be responsible for daily bank statement reconciliation, managing banking relationships, and supporting various financial operations. Key Responsibilities Upload all bank statements to Zoho Books daily for every company bank account. Reconcile all bank accounts daily and resolve unmatched items within 48 hours. Investigate unidentified receipts, bank charges, and discrepancies, then post or request correct entries. Prepare the daily cash position by bank for the Finance team. Follow up on all new LCs from receipt until proceeds are deposited. Verify LC terms and ensure all required documents (invoice, delivery note, certificate of origin, etc.) match before submission. Submit documents to banks, monitor bank review processes, and resolve discrepancies before LC expiry. Coordinate with Sales, Operations, and Accounts Receivable (AR) regarding LC status and expected collection dates. Deposit customer cheques at banks and track them until cleared. Handle returned cheques by recording reversals, informing AR and Sales, and following up. Maintain a comprehensive cheque register with status updates for all received and deposited cheques. Maintain an up-to-date tracker for all open LCs, cheques, and pending bank transactions, including status and expected dates. Support all company teams with banking requests such as transfers, bank letters, guarantees, account queries, and bank portal access. Act as the day-to-day contact for bank relationship managers. Support month-end close and audit requests by providing bank reconciliations and confirmations. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a treasury or banking accounting role. Proficiency in daily bank account reconciliation and cash position reporting. Experience with Letters of Credit (LCs) and cheque management processes. Familiarity with Zoho Books or similar accounting software. Strong attention to detail and accuracy in financial record-keeping. What We Offer Opportunity to contribute to a startup environment with significant responsibility and independence. A culture that values new ideas and continuous improvement. Stock options and premium health insurance. A competitive compensation package. Location and Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh. Application Process We invite qualified candidates to apply for this role.

9aabda3cbd4d883d.description: About the Role Bupa Arabia is seeking a Technician Cast to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position plays a vital role in supporting orthopedic physicians and healthcare professionals in the treatment and management of patients with musculoskeletal injuries and conditions. The role requires 2-5 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Apply, remove, repair, and modify casts, splints, braces, and orthopedic immobilization devices as prescribed by physicians. Assist physicians during fracture reduction procedures and orthopedic treatments. Prepare patients for casting procedures, ensuring proper positioning and comfort. Assess circulation, sensation, and movement before and after cast application. Monitor patients for signs of complications related to casting or splinting. Perform wound dressing changes associated with orthopedic treatment as directed. Ensure patient privacy and dignity throughout all procedures. Patient Education and Support Assess patient educational needs and educate patients and families regarding cast care, splint maintenance, and activity restrictions. Provide instructions on recognizing signs of complications such as swelling, pain, skin breakdown, or circulation issues. Reinforce physician treatment plans and follow-up requirements. Answer patient questions regarding orthopedic devices and recovery expectations. Provide emotional support to patients experiencing injury-related anxiety or discomfort. Collaboration and Documentation Collaborate with orthopedic surgeons, physicians, nurses, physiotherapists, and other healthcare professionals. Communicate relevant patient observations and concerns promptly. Coordinate patient flow to ensure efficient clinic operation. Accurately document casting procedures, patient assessments, interventions, and follow-up instructions in the Electronic Medical Record (EMR). Record materials used and any complications or concerns observed during treatment. Maintain complete and timely patient records, ensuring compliance with legal, ethical, and regulatory documentation standards. Safety and Professional Development Prepare and maintain casting materials, supplies, and orthopedic equipment, ensuring they are clean, functional, and properly stored. Follow infection prevention and control standards during all procedures. Identify and report defective equipment and environmental hazards. Adhere to workplace safety policies and emergency procedures. Maintain competency in casting techniques, orthopedic procedures, and patient care practices through continuous professional development. Participate in quality improvement initiatives and departmental audits. Qualifications Candidates should possess 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field. The role requires adherence to all relevant regulations, protocols, and safety standards to maintain a safe and efficient working environment. The Technician Cast will also assist the Head Nurse and orthopedic team with additional duties within the scope of practice and maintain current certifications required for the role.

9ad66454c150cb50.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة التقنية الألمانية للصيانة عن موظف صندوق محاسبة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الخبر، المنطقة الشرقية. تتضمن هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل مسؤولية إدارة المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية، وتسوية الحسابات، وتقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة. الدور متاح للمرشحين ذوي الخبرة التي تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية عد وتسجيل المبالغ المالية في آلة تسجيل النقود في بداية كل وردية، مع التأكد من توفر كمية كافية من العملات الصغيرة. استلام المدفوعات النقدية أو عن طريق بطاقات الائتمان أو أي طرق دفع أخرى معتمدة، ودفع المبالغ المتبقية، وإصدار الإيصالات اللازمة. تحديث قوائم الأسعار بشكل مستمر، وحساب أسعار السلع أو الخدمات، وإعداد جداول الفواتير، وتطبيق الخصومات عند الضرورة. تسوية النقدية الواردة مع إجمالي المبيعات في نهاية الوردية، والإبلاغ عن أي اختلافات أو تسويتها. التعامل مع العملاء بترحيب وتلبية طلباتهم المتعلقة بإضافة أو حذف عناصر من قوائم الشراء. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع المعاملات النقدية بدقة. مهارات جيدة في خدمة العملاء والتواصل. متطلبات العمل الالتزام بالعمل بدوام كامل. القدرة على العمل في بيئة سريعة الوتيرة. المرونة في التعامل مع مهام متعددة. موقع العمل تقع هذه الوظيفة في مدينة الخبر بالمنطقة الشرقية. تقديم الطلبات لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذه الوظيفة. يمكن للمرشحين المهتمين تقديم طلباتهم للانضمام إلى فريق شركة التقنية الألمانية للصيانة.

9af2003b0421eafb.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة لاين للتغليف عن كاتب إنتاج للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تنسيق تدفق المواد المطلوبة للإنتاج وضمان توافرها، بالإضافة إلى إعداد الجداول الزمنية للإنتاج. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع تقديرات استهلاك المواد الخام لكل إدارة بناءً على الجداول الزمنية، وتنسيق التدفق العام للمواد الخام. إعداد الجداول الزمنية لمتطلبات الإنتاج، وضمان توافر المواد اللازمة، ومتابعة الالتزام بالجداول الزمنية المحددة. تجميع وتسجيل بيانات الإنتاج، بما في ذلك حجم الإنتاج، مستوى الإنتاجية، الجودة، ومعدلات استهلاك المواد. التحقق من كفاية مخزون المواد الخام، والترتيب للشحنات من الموردين ومتابعتها لضمان وصولها في الوقت المحدد. إعداد تقارير الأداء الدورية ورفعها إلى إدارة الإنتاج لتقييم سير العمل واتخاذ القرارات اللازمة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تنسيق تدفق المواد وإدارة الجداول الزمنية بفعالية. مهارات جيدة في جمع البيانات وتحليلها وإعداد التقارير. بيئة العمل يعمل كاتب الإنتاج ضمن فريق شركة لاين للتغليف في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع لتنسيق العمليات الإنتاجية بشكل مباشر. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور لم يتم الكشف عنه وسيناقش خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

9a91a33cb5028e7d.description: We're looking for an experienced Commercial Director to lead commercial operations across project sales, tenders, retail/showroom sales, and marketing. The role is responsible for developing commercial strategies, managing sales teams, building strategic client relationships, and ensuring that sales commitments align with production capacity and business objectives. Key Responsibilities: Develop and implement annual commercial plans and sales targets across project sales, retail, and tenders. Lead and supervise project sales, field sales, showroom sales, tendering, and marketing activities. Set team targets, allocate responsibilities, and monitor performance against commercial objectives. Build and maintain strategic relationships with key clients, contractors, and consultants to expand project opportunities. Review and approve major commercial offers and contracts in coordination with the technical office and quality teams. Monitor monthly sales performance, analyze deviations from targets, and implement corrective actions. Coordinate with production and operations teams to ensure sales commitments align with available manufacturing capacity. Review pricing strategies and competitive market positioning in coordination with finance and marketing. Oversee marketing plans and participation in relevant exhibitions and industry events. Prepare periodic commercial performance reports covering sales, sales pipeline, and tender win rates for senior management. Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field. 7–10 years of experience in sales and business development, including 3–5 years in a leadership position. Hands-on experience managing project sales, retail/showroom sales, and tenders. Experience in aluminum, alumetal, or building materials is highly preferred. Proven experience leading sales teams across multiple sales channels. Strong commercial planning, negotiation, and key account management skills. Ability to analyze sales performance, market trends, competitor activity, and pricing strategies. Strong coordination skills to align commercial commitments with production and operational capabilities.

9a17090649a2f303.description: About Globe Alliance Company (GAC) Globe Alliance Company (GAC) is a dynamic and growing service-based organization headquartered in Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. GAC provides comprehensive and integrated business solutions across multiple sectors, specializing in delivering reliable, cost-effective, and professional services designed to improve efficiency, productivity, and operational excellence for organizations. Role Overview GAC is seeking a Sales Executive to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time, on-site position focused on driving sales within the Saudi market. The role requires a strong background in B2B sales and the ability to build and maintain client relationships. Key Responsibilities Achieving established sales targets. Creating and presenting proposals to potential clients. Conducting market research to identify opportunities. Delivering service presentations to prospective clients. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in sales. Demonstrated strong B2B sales background, specifically within the Saudi market. Excellent relationship-building skills. Proven ability to identify new business opportunities and develop strategic partnerships. Capability to convert prospects into long-term clients. Work Environment This is a full-time, on-site position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The Sales Executive will work directly from the company's premises. Application Process Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

9a56348f624065fe.description: About Air Products Air Products is a company focused on innovation, driven by the collective experience and motivation of its people. The company develops solutions that support various sectors, including space exploration, healthcare, and the construction of large-scale production facilities. Air Products is committed to safety, excellence, and moral integrity. The Role of Contracts Administrator Air Products is seeking a Contracts Administrator for a contract position in Al Jubail, Eastern Province. This role requires expertise in commercial, legal, and contractual matters, along with leadership and motivational skills. The Contracts Administrator will ensure project delivery aligns with Project, Business Unit, and Company objectives, while upholding the company's reputation and identifying potential risks and opportunities in accordance with established policies and regulations. Key Responsibilities Develop, negotiate, and manage commercial agreements and contracts to mitigate risk and optimize opportunities. Provide ongoing commercial and contract support, ensuring compliance with commercial practices. Support the pre and post-contract awards process. Demonstrate a competent understanding of contracts and their required administration. Ensure adequate staffing, both in numbers and quality, for contract requirements to meet project needs. Utilize professional experience to verify, oversee, negotiate, and/or approve commercial agreements with third parties. Comply with Lines and Limits of Authority. Analyze and report on complex situations and potential opportunities/risks related to variations in cost and schedule. Ensure procedures are followed and suggest improvements where applicable. Maintain good relations and facilitate information exchange between the company, contractors, and internal teams to ensure strategic alignment. Review contract specifications and collaborate with stakeholders (PM/PD) to identify risks or gaps. Engage the legal team when necessary for legal support. Protect business interests by ensuring contractual disputes are resolved promptly and diligently. Interpret commercial obligations for both contracts and clients, and brief relevant parties on the commercial/contractual impact of any failure to meet these obligations. Actively participate in the cross-functional project team, liaising with Engineering, Procurement, Operations, and other functions to identify and resolve potential concerns. Follow and comply with Company and Project procedures and techniques, suggesting beneficial updates or integrations. Implement good practice and strict controls for change orders, variations, and claims, including fee claim assessment and dispute resolution advice. Maintain contract logs/tracking sheets and adhere to reporting protocols. Support the claim and change management process. Qualifications and Experience A qualification in Quantity Surveying, Economics, Business, Engineering, Accounting, or a related discipline. 5-10 years of experience in the Oil & Gas, Energy, or Industrial Gases sectors. Competent knowledge and understanding of contract law and commercial/contracts management. Analytical skills for developing and utilizing performance measures and cost savings. Ability to work effectively in a multi-cultural environment. Strong sense of responsibility with a professional attitude and reputation. Proficiency in organizing, analyzing, and coordinating tasks. Knowledge of Saudi market vendors and suppliers. Skill in using the Internet and Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

9a8ea15de7349f74.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مدارس الوطن النموذجية الأهلية في المدينة المنورة عن معلم ثانوي فيزياء للانضمام إلى فريقها التعليمي. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تدريس طلاب المرحلة الثانوية في مجال الفيزياء، وتطوير خطط الدروس، وتقديم الدعم التعليمي الفردي والجماعي لتعزيز التنمية الأكاديمية للطلاب. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تطوير خطط الدروس بما يتوافق مع المنهج الدراسي والرؤية الأكاديمية للمدرسة، واختيار المصادر التعليمية، وتصميم المواد التعليمية والدروس. تدريس مادة الفيزياء لطلاب المرحلة الثانوية، وتقديم الدروس الفردية والجماعية، وتيسير المناقشات الصفية. إعداد الواجبات والاختبارات وإدارتها وتصحيحها لتقييم تقدم الطلاب، وتعميم أهداف تعليمية واضحة. تنظيم الرحلات والأنشطة العملية المتعلقة بمنهج الفيزياء. إدارة سلوك الطلاب وتفاعلاتهم داخل الصف وخارجه لضمان بيئة تعليمية إيجابية. تقديم المشورة للطلاب وأولياء أمورهم لتحسين الأداء الأكاديمي والسلوكي، وتحديد الطلاب الذين يحتاجون إلى دعم إضافي وتحديد الطرق المناسبة لتلبية احتياجاتهم. تسجيل الحضور والدرجات وأداء الطلاب بشكل فردي، وإعداد التقارير اللازمة. حضور اجتماعات الموظفين والتنسيق الفعال مع الزملاء المدرسين والمسؤولين ومساعدي المدرسين. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى 5 سنوات في تدريس مادة الفيزياء للمرحلة الثانوية. القدرة على وضع خطط الدروس وتصميم المواد التعليمية بفعالية. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والتفاعل مع الطلاب وأولياء الأمور. نوع العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل في المدينة المنورة. بيئة العمل يعمل المعلم ضمن فريق تعليمي في مدارس الوطن النموذجية الأهلية، ويسهم في بيئة أكاديمية داعمة تهدف إلى تطوير الطلاب. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه في هذه المرحلة.

9a29ecc25c5084dc.description: نظرة عامة على الوظيفة تبحث شركة ابراهيم ناصر التميمي للاستشارات الهندسية عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى المهندس المدني مسؤولية إعداد التصاميم الإنشائية، ومتابعة المخططات والجداول، والإشراف على تنفيذ المشاريع لضمان مطابقتها للمواصفات والمتطلبات الحكومية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية للمشاريع، وتحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة، وإجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل للعناصر. إعداد تصاميم المشاريع ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها. تدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات للمواد الإنشائية. الإشراف على تنفيذ المشاريع والتأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات والمعايير المحددة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الأعمال، ومطابقتها حسب متطلبات الجهات الحكومية المختصة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال الهندسي. عرض وتوضيح وحفظ الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسبة تقدمها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة المدنية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم الإنشائية ومتابعة المخططات. معرفة جيدة بجداول الكميات والمواصفات للمواد الإنشائية. القدرة على الإشراف على تنفيذ المشاريع ومطابقة المواصفات. نوع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. موقع العمل الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. التقديم نرحب بالمهندسين المدنيين الطموحين للانضمام إلى فريقنا والمساهمة في مشاريعنا الهندسية.

9aaf7b0f05782ded.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة فواز عبدالعزيز العمراني للمقاولات عن مدير إدارة مشاريع للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى الإشراف العام على أنشطة إدارة المشاريع والبرامج، ومتابعة عمليات تطوير خطط التنفيذ، ومراقبة سير العمل لضمان تحقيق الأهداف ضمن الجداول الزمنية والميزانيات المحددة. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0-1 سنة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على عمليات تطوير وتنفيذ خطط المشاريع والبرامج، وتوجيه ومتابعة تقدير الموازنات المالية وتحديد المتطلبات البشرية والتقنية والمعدات اللازمة لضمان توفيرها في الوقت المناسب وبتكلفة مقدرة. الإشراف على تحديد افتراضات المشروع والتداخلات البينية مع مشاريع أو برامج أخرى لضمان الاستغلال الأمثل للموارد المتاحة، وتحديد مخاطر المشروع ووضع الخطوات اللازمة لتفاديها وحلها. التنسيق مع فريق العمل
